name: Operating Systems
description: Role of OS and the challenges it faces in fairly and securely managing computer resources, like CPU, memory, and storage, while maintaining high performance; hardware-software interfaces: ISAs, interrupt descriptor tables, page tables; abstractions: processes, threads, address spaces, file systems, pipes, locks, semaphores, condition variables, barriers; mechanisms: address translation, context switching; correctness: races, deadlocks, crash consistency, security and access control.
